immutable_failure_reproduction.failed_job: Deploy dev under shared environment lease
immutable_failure_reproduction.observed_failure: HTTP 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR returned immediately during persona create-paper-bundle bootstrap
immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: Two unhandled runtime exceptions inside BFF persona creation handlers caused FastAPI to return a generic HTTP 500: (1) NameError: name 'build_persona_runtime_profile' is not defined inside _openclaw_agent_reconcile_request (main.py:47340, 48223) because build_persona_runtime_profile was defined in services/control-plane/bff/runtime_profile_builder.py but never imported at the module level in main.py; (2) AttributeError: 'ReadSurfacePorts' object has no attribute 'create_persona' inside _persona_record_for_provisioning (main.py:47533, 47563) because ReadSurfacePorts, PersonaCapitalRuntimeDomainPort, and PersonaFleetPort lacked create_persona and update_persona write/mutation methods. In addition, unhandled exceptions inside bff_create_persona were not mapped to a typed 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR envelope with structured diagnostics.

resolution_summary.runtime_profile_import: Added top-level import of build_persona_runtime_profile and PersonaRuntimeProfile in services/control-plane/bff/main.py with robust fallbacks and defensive exception handling in _openclaw_agent_reconcile_request.
resolution_summary.ports_write_facade: Implemented create_persona and update_persona in PersonaFleetPort and PersonaCapitalRuntimeDomainPort (services/control-plane/bff/domain_ports/persona_capital_runtime.py) as well as ReadSurfacePorts (services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py), enabling clean mutation delegation to underlying store or in-memory fallback dict.
resolution_summary.typed_diagnostics_envelope: Wrapped bff_create_persona coordinator invocation with structured 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR error mapping, surfacing actionable diagnostic reason, precondition_failed, suggestion, and provisioningState without leaking secrets.
resolution_summary.compose_contract_fix: Updated docker-compose.yml operator-bff PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL to use canonical environment fallback ${PANTHEON_REGISTRY_API_URL:-http://registry:8087} matching compose contract.
resolution_summary.deterministic_tests: Added comprehensive test suite services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_persona_provisioning_baseline_500.py covering reproduction imports and ports contract, clean dev paper baseline creation, idempotent retries, idempotency conflicts, typed 502 downstream error diagnostics, RBAC gates, and readback consistency.

fail_closed_boundaries: Unauthenticated requests are rejected with HTTP 401.
Non-operator roles (e.g. viewer) are rejected with HTTP 403.
Non-paper capital modes and non-low risk levels are rejected with HTTP 422.
Idempotency key reused with different request payload is rejected with HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Downstream coordinator or owner failures fail closed and return typed HTTP 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR with structured diagnostics, never generic 500.
Failure preserves compensation to exact accepted read-only FE/BFF baseline with all writes false.
